topic.name: 全球经济与金融
topic.description: 追踪增长、贸易、通胀、利率、金融市场与供应链
topic.query: global economy finance trade inflation interest rates

overview: 今日专题“全球经济与金融”。共筛选 21 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: Europe is entering a ‘supercycle’ of national elections. Their outcomes could shake the EU’s foundations
items.summary: The effects of the continent’s coming polls will be felt far and wide – and could well turn into ‘key tests’ of the bloc’s resilience In late 1998, Tony Blair was prime minister of Britain, Lionel Jospin was prime minister of France, and Gerhard Schröder had just been elected chancellor of Germany. The EU had 15 member states and pro-European, centre-left parties were in power – either alone or in coalitions – in all but two of them. Brisk economic growth was lifting living standards. Eastward enlargement was under way. In Washington, Bill Clinton was pursuing the same brand of “third way” centrism as a middle path between free-market capitalism and traditional socialism. The EU felt like it had the tide of history behind it. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 欧洲进入全国选举“超级周期”，结果可能动摇欧盟根基
items.summaryZh: 欧洲多国即将迎来一系列全国性选举，这些选举被视为对欧盟韧性的关键考验。选举结果可能改变欧洲的政治格局，并对欧盟的未来发展方向产生深远影响。
items.whyImportant: 欧洲政治版图的变动将直接影响欧盟的政策走向及全球地缘政治稳定性。

items.title: ‘Serious error of judgment’: outrage over military AI event at Berlin arts complex
items.summary: Kraftwerk Berlin, part of same development as techno club Tresor, transformed into ‘war room’ for arms firm event With their cavernous post-industrial venues, teeth-grinding four-by-four beats and bouncers that look like Blade Runner extras, Berlin’s nightclubs trade on a reputation for bleakness. A recent event at one of the city’s most legendary clubland institutions, however, has proven too dystopian even for seasoned techno-heads. On 11 November, the Kraftwerk Berlin arts complex had its central hall transformed into what visitors described as something resembling a war room, with maps and aerial footage projected on to concrete walls, drones hanging from the ceiling, and guards in flak jackets patrolling the premises with sniffer dogs. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: “严重的判断失误”：柏林艺术中心举办军事AI活动引发愤怒
items.summaryZh: 柏林著名的Kraftwerk艺术中心近日被改造成军火商的“作战室”，现场展示了地图、无人机及全副武装的警卫。这一充满反乌托邦色彩的活动在当地引发了强烈抗议。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了柏林文化界对军事化活动进入艺术空间的抵触情绪。

items.title: Thousands protest across Europe over living costs and housing
items.summary: Demonstrations in France and Portugal follow youth-led protests over education and economic hardship across Europe.
items.titleZh: 欧洲多地爆发抗议，民众不满生活成本与住房问题
items.summaryZh: 继青年群体针对教育和经济困境发起抗议后，法国和葡萄牙等地再次爆发大规模示威。民众对高昂的生活成本和住房危机表示强烈不满。
items.whyImportant: 欧洲范围内的抗议活动显示了经济压力正持续引发社会动荡。

items.title: Homes abandoned, harvests failing: Haiti’s farmers rebuild amid violence, hunger and El Niño
items.summary: Years of insecurity, violence perpetrated by murderous armed gangs and economic instability, combined with displacement, poor agricultural performance and climate shocks, have left millions of Haitians struggling to meet their food needs.
items.titleZh: 家园被弃、收成受损：海地农民在暴力、饥饿与厄尔尼诺现象中重建生活
items.summaryZh: 海地长期遭受武装团伙暴力、经济不稳定及气候冲击，导致数百万民众面临严重的粮食短缺。当地农民在极端困难的环境下艰难维持生计。
items.whyImportant: 海地的人道主义危机凸显了气候变化与社会动荡对脆弱国家粮食安全的叠加影响。

items.title: Hong Kong will not rule out whistle-blower immunity in bid-rigging law: minister
items.summary: Hong Kong authorities will not rule out the inclusion of immunity provisions for whistle-blowers in proposed legal amendments to outlaw bid-rigging in building maintenance and renovation projects, the commerce chief has said. Officials vowed to amend the law after an independent committee identified bid-rigging as one of the causes behind the Tai Po fire in November 2025 that claimed 168 lives and displaced almost 5,000 people. Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau...
items.titleZh: 香港商务及经济发展局局长：立法打击围标不排除给予举报人豁免权
items.summaryZh: 香港政府计划修法打击楼宇维修工程中的围标行为，商务及经济发展局局长表示，不排除在法例中加入举报人豁免条款。此举旨在根除导致大埔火灾等严重事故的行业弊病。
items.whyImportant: 引入举报人豁免机制有助于打破围标利益链，提升楼宇维修工程的透明度与安全性。

items.title: Police say man whose body lay undiscovered in Sydney bushland for 12 days was killed in suspected hit-and-run
items.summary: Joshua Howard, 31, is believed to have been struck by a car and thrown over the guardrail as he was walking home from a party in Rouse Hill Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast The twin brother of a man whose body lay undiscovered for 12 days after he was killed in a suspected hit and run in Sydney says it has left him feeling like half a person. Joshua Howard was last seen at a bus interchange in Parramatta, in western Sydney, about 10pm on 7 November. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 悉尼男子失踪12天后被发现，警方称其死于疑似肇事逃逸
items.summaryZh: 31岁的约书亚·霍华德在从派对回家的路上疑似被车撞倒并抛出护栏。他的遗体在失踪12天后才被发现，其双胞胎兄弟对此深感悲痛。
items.whyImportant: 此案引发了公众对道路安全及失踪人口搜救效率的关注。

items.title: Dozens missing as deadly fire hits Indonesian candy factory
items.summary: A fire at a confectionery factory in Indonesia's Banten province has killed at least three people. Dozens are also unaccounted for after the blaze, which destroyed large parts of the facility.
items.titleZh: 印尼糖果厂发生致命火灾，数十人失踪
items.summaryZh: 印度尼西亚万丹省一家糖果厂发生火灾，造成至少3人死亡。火灾摧毁了工厂大部分设施，目前仍有数十人下落不明。
items.whyImportant: 此次工业事故造成的人员伤亡引发了对当地工厂安全标准的担忧。

items.title: New draft deal aims to avert collapse of talks at climate summit
items.summary: The UN COP31 meeting in Turkey enters a second day of overtime as countries struggle to reach an agreement.
items.titleZh: 新草案旨在避免气候峰会谈判破裂
items.summaryZh: 在土耳其举行的联合国COP31气候峰会进入延长期。各国代表正努力就新草案达成共识，以避免谈判彻底失败。
items.whyImportant: 气候峰会的谈判结果直接影响全球应对气候变化的政策方向。

items.title: Labour MPs sign up for leadership course to counter rightwing populism
items.summary: Course run by former No 10 advisers is funded by Gary Lubner, who has given more than £11m to Labour More than 20 Labour MPs have signed up to a year-long leadership course helping them to counter rightwing populism and deal with hostility, run by two former No 10 advisers and ultimately funded by multimillionaire donor Gary Lubner. The training courses worth about £9,600 are being led by Ruth Turner, who was Tony Blair’s director of government relations, and Peter Hyman, who has worked for Blair, Keir Starmer and Andy Burnham’s governments. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 工党议员参加领导力课程以应对右翼民粹主义
items.summaryZh: 超过20名工党议员参加了一项为期一年的领导力培训课程，旨在学习如何应对右翼民粹主义及政治敌意。该课程由前首相顾问领导，并由富豪捐赠者资助。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了英国工党在政治极化背景下加强议员应对能力的策略。

items.title: Australia-Philippine deal exposes where Asean’s architecture is weakest
items.summary: The most revealing moment of the 49th Asean summit in Manila might have occurred beyond the plenary hall. On November 15, as Southeast Asian governments gathered to reaffirm regional cooperation, Australia and the Philippines signed a new defence cooperation arrangement intended to make their military partnership more practical. The timing was striking: the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) was celebrating its central role even as two partners were building security mechanisms...
items.titleZh: 澳菲协议暴露东盟架构的薄弱环节
items.summaryZh: 在东盟峰会期间，澳大利亚与菲律宾签署了新的防务合作协议。此举被认为在东盟强调区域合作的同时，凸显了其在安全机制上的局限性。
items.whyImportant: 该协议反映了亚太地区在多边框架之外寻求双边安全保障的趋势。

items.title: A year of grief: Tai Po fire residents on coping with loss and trying to move on
items.summary: What has life been like for the residents of Wang Fuk Court displaced by the deadly blaze of last November? Lo Hoi-ying speaks to residents as part of a series on the first anniversary of the Tai Po fire. Vivian Lee had just finished lunch and was resting at home when she smelled smoke. At first, the 70-year-old housewife thought her domestic helper had burnt something in the kitchen. She was inspecting her hob when a neighbour knocked on her door to warn them of a fire at Wang Cheong House, six...
items.titleZh: 悲伤的一年：大埔火灾居民讲述如何应对失去与尝试重新生活
items.summaryZh: 去年11月大埔宏福苑发生致命火灾，导致大量居民流离失所。在火灾一周年之际，媒体采访了受灾居民，回顾他们过去一年在失去家园后的生活与心理重建过程。
items.whyImportant: 该报道关注灾后居民的心理健康与生活重建，反映了重大公共安全事故对社区的长期影响。

items.title: Victorian Greens win injunction over how-to-vote cards mimicking party’s branding but preferencing it last
items.summary: Exclusive: Independent candidate Tosh-Jake Finnigan’s cards instructed people to vote in a way that would benefit Liberal party Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast The Victorian Greens have won a supreme court injunction to stop an independent candidate from handing out how to vote cards that mimic their branding and urge people to preference it last. The decision has been welcomed by the party’s leader, Ellen Sandell, who said the flyers distributed by people wearing the exact same colour shirts as genuine Greens volunteers had already misled voters. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 维多利亚州绿党赢得禁令，阻止模仿其品牌但将其排在投票意向末位的“投票指南”
items.summaryZh: 维多利亚州绿党成功申请最高法院禁令，阻止一名独立候选人发放模仿绿党品牌形象的投票指南。该指南误导选民，将绿党排在投票意向的最后一位，引发了关于选举公平性的争议。
items.whyImportant: 此案凸显了选举中利用品牌混淆误导选民的风险，对维护选举公正性具有法律参考意义。

items.title: Hong Kong temperatures to fall to 16 degrees midweek as monsoon arrives
items.summary: Hong Kong is expected to turn chilly midweek, with temperatures dropping to 16 degrees Celsius (60.8 Fahrenheit) as a northeast monsoon brings cloudy skies and rain, according to the forecaster. The Hong Kong Observatory said on Sunday a fresh to strong easterly airstream would bring cloudier conditions to southern China over the next two days. Winds are forecast to turn northerly midweek, pushing temperatures down to between 16 and 20 degrees on Wednesday. In the New Territories, temperatures...
items.titleZh: 受东北季候风影响，香港周中气温将降至16度
items.summaryZh: 香港天文台预计，受东北季候风影响，本周中期香港天气将转凉，气温将降至16至20摄氏度。届时将伴随多云及降雨天气，新界地区气温可能更低。
items.whyImportant: 气温骤降提醒市民注意保暖，并对户外活动及健康状况产生直接影响。

items.title: Experts call for stronger reef protection as 20% of coral survey sites bleached
items.summary: About 20 per cent of Hong Kong’s coral survey sites recorded minor bleaching this year, as experts called for stronger measures to protect the marine habitats from potential climate effects. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department shared the latest data with the South China Morning Post on Friday, saying minor coral bleaching was common during the summer months in Hong Kong. However, experts said mitigation measures, such as installing shading to shield corals from UV light,...
items.titleZh: 专家呼吁加强珊瑚保护，20%的珊瑚调查点出现白化现象
items.summaryZh: 香港今年约20%的珊瑚调查点记录到轻微白化现象。专家呼吁采取更强有力的保护措施，如安装遮阳设施以减少紫外线影响，应对气候变化对海洋生态的威胁。
items.whyImportant: 珊瑚白化是气候变化影响海洋生态的警示，加强保护对维护香港生物多样性至关重要。

items.title: Hong Kong Election Committee race: turnout hits nearly 90%, exceeding 2021 total
items.summary: A total of 856 candidates are vying for 723 seats across the 31 subsectors. The elected members will join 259 members from five uncontested subsectors, 362 ex officio members and 156 members nominated by designated bodies to form the 1,500-strong electoral college. The key body will nominate and vote in next year’s chief executive election, and will nominate candidates and elect 40 of the 90 lawmakers in the 2029 Legislative Council election. The second Election Committee poll since Beijing’s...
items.titleZh: 香港选举委员会选举：投票率接近90%，超过2021年总数
items.summaryZh: 香港选举委员会选举投票率接近90%，超过了2021年的水平。选出的委员将组成1500人的选举委员会，负责提名及选出下任行政长官，并参与立法会议员的提名与选举。
items.whyImportant: 高投票率反映了选民对新选举制度下选委会职能的关注，该机构在香港政治架构中扮演核心角色。

items.title: Hong Kong’s Election Committee race: how voting works and new candidates to watch
items.summary: Hong Kong goes to the polls on Sunday for some 5,700 eligible voters to choose members of the powerful Election Committee, a 1,500-strong electoral college that will nominate candidates and elect the city leader in next year’s chief executive race, as well as nominate candidates and elect legislators in the 2029 Legislative Council election. Here is what you need to know about the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections and the candidates to watch. 1. What is the Election...
items.titleZh: 香港选举委员会选举：投票机制及值得关注的新候选人
items.summaryZh: 香港举行选举委员会界别分组一般选举，约5700名合资格选民参与投票。此次选举选出的委员将负责未来行政长官及立法会议员的提名与选举工作。
items.whyImportant: 选委会选举是香港政治体制的重要组成部分，其结果直接影响未来政府领导人及立法机构的产生。

items.title: Lock of former US President George Washington's hair sells for $4,000
items.summary: The hair was given as a sign of friendship shortly before Washington's death in 1799, according to a descendent of its former owner.
items.titleZh: 美国前总统乔治·华盛顿的一缕头发以4000美元售出
items.summaryZh: 据前拥有者的后代称，这缕头发是在华盛顿1799年去世前作为友谊的象征赠送的。该物品近期在拍卖中以4000美元的价格成交。
items.whyImportant: 这一拍卖事件反映了历史名人遗物在收藏市场中持续存在的价值与关注度。

items.title: Bessent confirms he’s living on US military base over Iran fears
items.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says he’s still living at a US military base, two weeks after an Israeli warning.
items.titleZh: 贝森特证实因担忧伊朗威胁而居住在美军基地
items.summaryZh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示，在收到以色列的警告两周后，他目前仍居住在美军基地内。此举凸显了政府高层对潜在安全威胁的重视。
items.whyImportant: 该消息揭示了当前地缘政治紧张局势下，美国高级官员面临的安全风险及防范措施。

items.title: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
items.summary: Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores, who is accused of drug trafficking and torture, is detained after gun fight with authorities.
items.titleZh: FBI十大通缉要犯名单中的墨西哥毒枭在枪战中被捕
items.summaryZh: 被控贩毒和酷刑的法乌斯托·伊西德罗·梅萨·弗洛雷斯在与当局的枪战后被捕。他此前一直位列联邦调查局的十大通缉要犯名单。
items.whyImportant: 此次逮捕行动是打击跨国贩毒集团的重要进展，有助于削弱相关犯罪组织的势力。

items.title: French police officers jailed for racist violence against black man in landmark ruling
items.summary: The lawyer for a black man who was beaten up by three French police officers hailed a “historic ruling” on Saturday after a court acknowledged the racist nature of the violence and sentenced them to between one and two years in prison. The assault on Michel Zecler, a music producer, took place six years ago during the coronavirus pandemic and was caught on camera. It showed the officers repeatedly punching him, using a truncheon and tear gas against him for no apparent reason. Zecler said after...
items.titleZh: 法国警察因对黑人实施种族主义暴力被判入狱，裁决具有里程碑意义
items.summaryZh: 三名法国警察因六年前殴打音乐制作人米歇尔·泽克勒被判处一至两年监禁。法院认定该暴力行为具有种族主义性质，受害者律师称此裁决具有历史意义。
items.whyImportant: 该判决标志着法国司法系统在处理执法人员种族歧视和暴力问题上迈出了重要一步。

items.title: Man charged with attempted murder after councillor stabbed in Bradford
items.summary: Arfan Ali, 31, has also been charged with assault and possession of an offensive weapon in a public place A man has been charged with attempted murder after a local councillor was stabbed while working in the community in Bradford, police have said. Arfan Ali, 32, is accused of attacking Ibrar Ali, 52, at about 11am on Thursday in the West Yorkshire city. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 布拉德福德议员遇刺，一名男子被控谋杀未遂
items.summaryZh: 31岁的阿尔凡·阿里因在布拉德福德袭击当地议员伊布拉尔·阿里而被控谋杀未遂、袭击及非法持有攻击性武器。袭击事件发生于周四上午，目前警方已介入调查。
items.whyImportant: 针对民选官员的暴力袭击引发了公众对社区安全及政治人物人身保护的担忧。
